description:
The Google keywords any domain ranks for (its own or a competitor's), by the traffic each sends: position, ranking URL, volume, CPC, difficulty, intent; plus totals (organic keywords, estimated monthly traffic and its ad value, new / up / down / lost). Data: DataForSEO's Google index, monthly; estimates, not Search Console numbers.

Billing: 10¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call within 24h is free. No-account server: one free data call a day without credit.

When to call: what a domain ranks for (a competitor's best pages, a site's keyword footprint). A connected site's real clicks: query_search_console; ideas for a topic: keyword_research.

Returns { domain, country, totals, coverage: {indexed_keywords, confidence: low|medium|high, note}, keywords: [{keyword, position, previous_position, url, search_volume, cpc_usd, keyword_difficulty, intent, estimated_traffic}], volume_source, cached, charged_cents }. position is organic; previous_position last month's. estimated_traffic = volume × the click-through rate at that position (#1 ≈ 28%, #10 ≈ 2%, page 2 ≈ 1–0.5%, past 30 none). coverage.confidence low (under 100 indexed keywords): the index sees only part of a small site's queries.

country.description: Google market, ISO code (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, IN, SG, ZA, AE, DE, AT, CH, FR, ES, IT, NL, SE, FI, MX, BR). Default from the TLD.

name: get_domain_keywords
title: Keywords any domain ranks for in Google
